description: We’re Aanya and Aaira, two high-school students and best friends since birth. We’ve grown up side by side, sharing childhood memories, endless questions and a curiosity about the world. Aanya loves computer science, data science, maths and economics, especially finding meaning in data. Aaira is fascinated by Earth, space and planetary science. Our interests may be different, but growing up together has taught us how much we can discover when we combine them.
